About.title: About Me
About.description: I am a detail-oriented Frontend Developer based in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. With hands-on experience in building ERP and LMS platforms, I excel at crafting modular, performant user interfaces using TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI. I leverage Redux, Zustand, and React Query for complex state and data flow.

Fun.sectionSubtitle: Exploring high-altitude peaks, pushing endurance limits in marathons, and embracing nature.

newUzbekistan.title: New Uzbekistan Annual Run 2026
newUzbekistan.subtitle: 5km Winner Champion
newUzbekistan.shortDesc: Won 1st Place overall in the 5km race at the NewUU x ADM Annual Run 2026, earning the official winner trophy and certificate.
newUzbekistan.p1: Competing in the New Uzbekistan Annual Run 2026 was a defining athletic milestone. With hundreds of competitive runners from across the country, the atmosphere at New Uzbekistan Park was incredible.
newUzbekistan.p2: Maintaining an aggressive pace throughout the 5km course, I crossed the finish line under 20 minutes, securing 1st Place overall in the tournament.
newUzbekistan.p3: Receiving the official Winner Certificate and award framed at the podium was a proud reward for months of disciplined morning track training.

bukhara.title: Bukhara Night Race 2025
bukhara.subtitle: 10km Night Marathon
bukhara.shortDesc: Completed the 10km distance through the illuminated Silk Road ancient monuments of historic Bukhara.
bukhara.p1: Running the Bukhara Night Race was an unforgettable cultural and sporting event. The route wove through centuries-old madrasahs and ancient minarets bathed in glowing lights.
bukhara.p2: Finished the 10km marathon with strong endurance alongside running enthusiasts, earning the official Bukhara Night Race finisher medal.

bigChimgan.title: Big Chimgan Summit (3,309m)
bigChimgan.subtitle: Highest Peak in Tashkent Region
bigChimgan.shortDesc: Summited Big Chimgan Peak (Katta Chimyon) at 3,309 meters elevation in the Chatkal mountain range.
bigChimgan.p1: Scaling Big Chimgan Peak (3,309m elevation) is considered the ultimate high-altitude test for mountaineers in Tashkent. The ascent requires navigating steep rock scrambles and alpine ridges.
bigChimgan.p2: Reaching the metallic summit triangulation frame above the clouds and waving the national flag was a surreal, exhilarating accomplishment.

begiztash.title: Begiztash Peak Summit (2,025m)
begiztash.subtitle: Winter High Altitude Trek
begiztash.shortDesc: Challenging winter ascent to Begiztash Peak at 2,025m altitude through sub-zero snow and icy mountain ridges.
begiztash.p1: Begiztash Peak (Height: 2,025m) provided a rugged winter trekking adventure. Navigating deep powder snow and icy ridge winds demanded absolute mental resilience.
begiztash.p2: Posing at the summit marker with the mountain expanse stretching across the horizon was proof that determination conquers every slope.
